title: An integrated machine learning approach delineates an entropic expansion mechanism for the binding of a small molecule to alpha-synuclein.
authors: Menon, Sneha; Adhikari, Subinoy; Mondal, Jagannath
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度神经网络机器学习区分alpha-synuclein无序蛋白在水与fasudil小分子溶液中的构象系综，揭示小分子通过熵调控和系综扩展机制结合IDP，虽对象为IDP-小分子而非PPI，但机制建模思路对无序蛋白互作研究有直接启发。
abstract: The mis-folding and aggregation of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) such as alpha-synuclein (alphaS) underlie the pathogenesis of various neurodegenerative disorders. However, targeting alphaS with small molecules faces challenges due to the lack of defined ligand-binding pockets in its disordered structure. Here, we implement a deep artificial neural network-based machine learning approach, which is able to statistically distinguish the fuzzy ensemble of conformational substates of alphaS in neat water from those in aqueous fasudil (small molecule of interest) solution. In particular, the presence of fasudil in the solvent either modulates pre-existing states of alphaS or gives rise to new conformational states of alphaS, akin to an ensemble-expansion mechanism. The ensembles display strong conformation-dependence in residue-wise interaction with the small molecule. A thermodynamic analysis indicates that small-molecule modulates the structural repertoire of alphaS by tuning protein backbone entropy, however entropy of the water remains unperturbed. Together, this study sheds light on the intricate interplay between small molecules and IDPs, offering insights into entropic modulation and ensemble expansion as key biophysical mechanisms driving potential therapeutics.
abstract_zh: α-突触核蛋白（alpha-synuclein, alphaS）等固有无序蛋白（intrinsically disordered proteins, IDPs）的错误折叠和聚集是多种神经退行性疾病发病机制的基础。然而，由于alphaS的无序结构缺乏明确的配体结合口袋，用小分子靶向alphaS面临挑战。在此，我们实施了一种基于深度人工神经网络的机器学习方法，该方法能够统计区分alphaS在纯水中的模糊构象亚态集合与在水溶液法舒地尔（fasudil，目标小分子）中的构象亚态集合。特别地，溶剂中法舒地尔的存在要么调节alphaS的既有状态，要么产生alphaS的新构象状态，类似于集合扩展机制。这些集合在残基水平与小分子的相互作用中表现出强烈的构象依赖性。热力学分析表明，小分子通过调节蛋白质主链熵来调控alphaS的结构库，而水的熵保持不变。总体而言，本研究揭示了小分子与IDPs之间复杂的相互作用，为熵调节和集合扩展作为驱动潜在治疗的关键生物物理机制提供了见解。
